title: Radio Check
reference: forward forward forward forward activate radio forward def DASH { forward listen forward forward forward }
hints: Counting waits works, but it is a lot of waits. A radio call tells DASH exactly when.
LoopBot radios right after it flips the switch. DASH walks to the door, then waits for radio.
forward forward forward forward activate radio forward def DASH { forward listen forward forward forward }

story.intro: DASH: "New toys! Radio sends a call to your partner. Wait for radio holds a bot until a call comes in. Ten-four, good buddy!"
story.outro: BULWARK: "Look at that timing! Not a single wasted wait. I might cry. I am crying."
